records.issue_text: GroupsController#members takes `limit` directly from user-controlled params with no upper bound, and the action is accessible to any user who can view the group (not admin-gated), allowing arbitrarily large queries/payloads
records.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, `limit` is set from `params[:limit]` (`limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i`) with no maximum enforced, and the endpoint is in `GroupsController` (not admin) guarded only by `guardian.ensure_can_see!(group)` in `find_group`. This allows any user who can view the group to request an arbitrarily large `limit`, potentially causing heavy DB queries and large JSON response

records.issue_text: admin/groups_controller.rb add_members does `usernames.split(",")` without trimming whitespace, causing usernames with leading spaces (e.g. from "foo, bar") to fail lookup via User.find_by_username and be silently skipped
records.rationale: In Admin::GroupsController#add_members, the diff shows `usernames.split(",").each do |username|` followed by `User.find_by_username(username)`. There is no `strip`/whitespace normalization on each `username`, so inputs like "foo, bar" would yield " bar" for the second entry and likely fail lookup, silently skipping that user due to the `if user = ...` guard.

records.issue_text: group.js findMembers, addMembers, and removeMember AJAX calls have no .catch/error handling, so failed requests fail silently with no feedback to the admin
records.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`, the new/changed async methods `findMembers`, `addMembers`, and `removeMember` all call `Discourse.ajax(...).then(...)` without any local rejection handling (`.catch`/error callback).
